notes: Page 2 only shows how to open the numbered bags (bags 1 and 2). It has no building step, so no pieces or joins are added.

Page 4 shows the bag 1 contents preview and the lumberjack minifigure being assembled (helmet, head, torso, legs, shovel). The minifigure parts are not in the parts list, so no pieces are recorded here. The shovel (lego-3837) is held by the minifigure, not joined to another brick, so no join is added.

Page 5 builds a small chainsaw: black 1x1 studs-on-4-sides brick (b1), orange cone on one side stud (b2), chainsaw blade on the opposite side stud (b3), orange round tile on a third side stud (b4), and a black T-shaped piece on top (b5). Which side stud each piece uses (side.1, side.2, side.3) is a guess. The picture only shows them on different sides.

The minifigure and its ear protectors are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded. The chainsaw is held by the minifigure, so no join is added for that.
The output format has no pieces or other_joins fields, so placed pieces go in parts and the joins go in edges. The rests_on information is expressed as joined edges.
Page 6 starts the first log. Step 1 places a reddish brown round brick with axle hole (b8). Step 2 pushes a black Technic axle 12 (b9) into its axle hole.
The preview shows two logs. Only one build is shown on this page, with no 2x box, so I record one copy. The second log is expected to be built in later steps.

Step 4 shows the 4-bars-up plate near the top of the stack with the axle sticking out above it. I assumed it sits on the top brick.
Page 8 step 5 adds three more reddish brown round bricks (b15 to b17) above the 4-bars-up plate (b14) on the first log, with the axle b9 through them.

Page 9 step 6 adds the last two bricks (b18, b19) to the first log. The first log is then done: 10 round bricks, one 4-bars-up plate and one axle.

PARTS-LIST FIXES. Some earlier pieces had the wrong type. I re-listed them above under the same ids with the corrected type, so the new entries replace the old ones. Everything else stays as given.
b5, the black piece on top of the 1x1 studs-on-4-sides brick, is the chainsaw handle, lego-60849 (hose nozzle). It was wrongly lego-60897. This also uses up the missing 60849.

b138 and b139, the two cab-roof clip pieces the beacons clip onto, are lego-12825 (tile with clip), not lego-60897. This uses up the two missing 12825. With b5, b138 and b139 retyped, the 60897 count is exactly 10.
b51, the bracket at the right end of the chassis, is lego-11215 (the 5x2 bracket), not lego-99780. That leaves two 99780 (b55, b56).
b182, the ribbed piece that takes the red axle on page 61, is lego-30552 (hinge cylinder with axle holes), not lego-6628. The only lego-6628 is now b198, the towball pin on the grabber.

b219 is the lumberjack's shovel, lego-3837, which was in the parts list but never recorded. The booklet shows it held by the minifigure, so it joins nothing and the minifigure is not in the parts list.
Old edges that used ports the corrected types do not have (b5, b51, b182) are replaced by the new edges above, which use the right ports.

CONNECTIVITY. The two logs (b8 to b19 and b21 to b31) are loaded onto the truck bed on page 74, so I added contact edges to the deck plates. I also added blocks edges because the stakes (b167, b168) stop the logs being removed sideways.
